[...] quickstart.rst`, `llms.txt` and `README.md`. Its docs URL stops resolving.

## Coverage test

`tests/test_tutorial_coverage.py` computes the names from the package (every `cx.pp`/`pb`/`tl`/`pl` method, plus every top-level name the namespaces do not wrap) and fails, naming the function, when one appears in no `basics_*.ipynb`. `plot_benchmark_comparison` is the one exclusion; a second test fails on an exclusion that is no longer needed.

## Library fixes found while writing the notebooks

- **`cx.detect_gene_symbol_column`** (and so `cx.infer_columns` and the hint in `cx.pp.check_data`) took any `var` column that did not look like Ensembl IDs for the gene symbols: `feature_types` on a file from `read_10x_mtx`, and a count or a flag as well. Only a text column whose values are mostly distinct is a candidate now.
- **`cx.write_obs` / `cx.write_var`** failed with HDF5's "already open for read-only" when a `cx.AnnData` in the same process had the file open. Open wrappers are tracked in a weak set and the in-place table writer closes the ones on its file first; each reopens on its next access. This replaces `_close_backed`. A handle crispyx does not own (h5py, a backed anndata object) gives an error that says so.
- **Progress bars of `highly_variable_genes` and `pca`** ignored `TQDM_DISABLE`, which silences every other crispyx bar: they are drawn through the shared helper now. They are plain tqdm bars where they were notebook widgets.

## Other docs

- `quality_control.rst` documents `cx.pp.subsample`, which was on no guide page.
- The README no longer says crispyx starts from an `.h5ad` file only.

## Verification

- The three notebooks were executed from empty output folders: no error, no warning banner, no machine path in any output. They render in a Sphinx build with all figures and no broken local link.
- Full suite: 1,198 passed on the default environment and on Python 3.12 pinned to CI's versions.
